hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "$d/hooks/start.py" --program codex 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.commandWindows: $d=(Get-Location).ProviderPath; while($d -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.codex/hooks.json'))){ $d=Split-Path -Parent $d }; if(-not $d){ exit 0 }; $f=Join-Path $d 'hooks/start.py'; py -3 $f --program codex 2>$null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ python3 $f --program codex 2>$null }; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ python $f --program codex 2>$null }; exit 0
